title: Introduction to the companion GitHub Repository

cues.en: Together with this course, there is a sample repository up on GitHub that you can access.
cues.zh: 這門課附有一個 GitHub 範例儲存庫，你可以直接存取。

cues.en: It's called Agent Framework Course, and inside it there will be samples and all the source code that will be shown in this course
cues.zh: 名稱是 Agent Framework Course，裡面包含從現在開始，課程所展示的所有範例

cues.en: from this point on.
cues.zh: 以及原始碼。

cues.en: If you wish to discuss something, you can go to the discussion part, or if you
cues.zh: 如果想討論任何事情，可以到 Discussions；如果

cues.en: have some issues, go to the issue part like normal GitHub.
cues.zh: 遇到問題，就和一般 GitHub 專案一樣，到 Issues 回報。

cues.en: The URL for the repo is down here, but also in the resources of this lecture.
cues.zh: 儲存庫網址在畫面下方，本講座的資源裡也有。

cues.en: Inside, you will see a solution called Agent Framework Course that have primarily two projects.
cues.zh: 裡面有一個名為 Agent Framework Course 的方案，主要包含兩個專案。

cues.en: If we need in some of the bonus content to make separate projects on that, I will put those in as well, because a
cues.zh: 後續補充內容如果需要另外建立專案，我也會一併放進來，因為這樣的

cues.en: repo like this is a living thing that gets more and more as we go along.
cues.zh: 儲存庫會持續更新，內容也會越來越多。

cues.en: But what I've done is I've put in all the samples into the different sections that are in this course, and for example, in
cues.zh: 我把所有範例依照本課章節分類。例如，

cues.en: section three, which we are at right now, we will see something about token usage, so there will be a token usage sample inside
cues.zh: 目前的第 3 章會介紹 Token 用量，因此第 3 章的資料夾裡會有 Token 用量範例，

cues.en: section three, while section four is all about chat and so on and so forth.
cues.zh: 第 4 章則都是對話相關內容，以此類推。

cues.en: So you can get the defaults here.
cues.zh: 這裡可以取得預設設定。

cues.en: You can configure what defaults you want in the system, and in this, you can put in your own credentials using secrets, so you
cues.zh: 你可以設定系統要使用的預設值，並透過使用者秘密填入自己的認證資訊。

cues.en: simply right-click and add the user secrets to this part, so you can run them.
cues.zh: 只要在這個專案按右鍵，加入 User Secrets，就能執行範例。

cues.en: And for running them, there is the sample console run.
cues.zh: 執行範例使用的是 SampleConsoleRunner。

cues.en: It's a one-liner inside the programme.cs of this, where you just go in and see what sample you wish to run.
cues.zh: 它的 Program.cs 只需要一行，選擇你想執行的範例即可。

cues.en: So if you want to run the sample about chat loops, you choose that sample, or if you want to be shown an interactive
cues.zh: 例如，要執行對話迴圈範例，就選那個範例；如果希望顯示互動式

cues.en: page of what you want to choose, you simply choose the interactive here, and it will
cues.zh: 選單，再從中選擇，就選這裡的 Interactive，接著它會

cues.en: show you what section we are in, so in this case, it would be the section before we dive deeper, and there will be
cues.zh: 依照課程章節列出選項。例如目前是「深入之前」這個章節，裡面會有

cues.en: a sample on token usage.
cues.zh: Token 用量範例。

cues.en: In chat, that would be about streaming response, chat and so on.
cues.zh: 對話章節裡則有串流回應、對話等範例。

cues.en: So you have the option.
cues.zh: 你可以自行選擇。

cues.en: You see a number.
cues.zh: 每個範例都有一個編號。

cues.en: You put in that number, and it will run that sample.
cues.zh: 輸入那個編號，就會執行對應範例。

cues.en: So let's see that in action.
cues.zh: 來實際操作看看。

cues.en: So if I'm here, and I want to run a sample, say interactive, I can then
cues.zh: 如果現在想執行範例，先選 Interactive，然後

cues.en: run it, and we get this, and I can say I want to see sample 300,
cues.zh: 啟動程式，會看到這個畫面。假設我想看範例 300，

cues.en: and it will run sample 300, which you haven't seen yet, but this is the next video in this series.
cues.zh: 就會執行範例 300。你目前還沒看過，這正是系列中下一段影片的內容。

cues.en: If you want to run them again and again, we could say, okay, we want the token usage sample, so we take that, and
cues.zh: 如果想反覆執行相同範例，例如 Token 用量，就直接選取它，

cues.en: it will run that directly instead of asking for interactive.
cues.zh: 程式便會直接執行，不再詢問互動式選單。

cues.en: That is how you would use it sitting and trying it out, and if you want to find the token usage, it's over here,
cues.zh: 自己動手練習時就可以這樣使用。如果要找 Token 用量的程式碼，它在這裡，

cues.en: so we can find it and go through it in details.
cues.zh: 可以找到後再深入閱讀。

cues.en: So that's everything there is to using the sample repo, but again, if there's issues or
cues.zh: 以上就是範例儲存庫的用法。再次提醒，如果有問題或

cues.en: discussions, please put them into the GitHub repo.
cues.zh: 想討論的內容，請到 GitHub 儲存庫提出。
